imv.name: Falling Hearts
imv.description: What better way to show you care, than with an IMVironment that comes from the heart. For that extra special someone, use the buzz feature (Ctrl + G) to give your loved one a virtual kiss.

imv.name: Autumn Leaves
imv.description: Watch autumn leaves fall with this IMVironment, and make them blow with the wind when you Buzz your friends (Ctrl + G).

imv.name: Precious Moments
imv.description: Send a smile to friends and family with this adorable Precious Moments IMVironment. Scroll through five totally cute Precious Moment backgrounds, then hit Ctrl-G to share a giggle and some instant message fun.

imv.name: Dilbert
imv.description: Dilbert is still stuck in his cubicle, but now he's back with a new Messenger IMV! Dilbert works on his desktop computer as Dogbert looks on. Be sure to buzz your friends (Ctrl+G) and see what Dogbert really thinks of Dilbert.

imv.name: Peanuts
imv.description: The gang from Peanuts is back in a whole new IMVironment. Charlie Brown eagerly checks his mail, and be sure to buzz your friend to see what's waiting for him. Click to visit the Peanuts official site, or get Peanuts in your e-mail box.

imv.name: Garfield
imv.description: Look who's raiding the refrigerator... it's your old pal Garfield! Andy our friend can help him rummage for a tasty snack simply by typing a message to you. Be sure to buzz a friend (Ctrl + G) to see another snacktime visitor.

imv.name: Fishtank
imv.description: Looking for a virtual fish tank to calm your day? Download our Fishtank IMVironment and watch the colorful fishes swim around effortlessly. A great way to relieve stress as you chat with a friend or have it open in your desktop while you work.

imv.name: Snowflakes
imv.description: Start a virtual snowball fight with your friends using the Snowflake IMV! Just open it up, hit buzz (Control + G) and watch the snowballs fly!

imv.name: Doodle
imv.description: Everyone has a little bit of an artistic streak in them. Express yourself, and create a great work of art with your friends with this neat IMVironment! After you're done, you can print your work of art to show off to your friends and family. Or if drawing isn't your thing, there are some neat games to try.

imv.name: Yahoo Search
imv.description: Looking for something on the Internet with your friends? Why paste links back and forth when you can search together in an IMVironment? Search, then share the links with your friends, all in one message window!

imv.name: Emoticats
imv.description: Love emoticons? Now you can adopt an "Emoticat®" as your display image or just insert one into your conversation. Open it up and start turning the cat photos into emoticons by zooming in on each cat!

imv.name: Football Kick
imv.description: Think you've got a winning foot? Challenge your friend to a game of Football Kick to determine a champion. Use the arrow keys to adjust the direction of the ball, and then hold the spacebar down to let it fly. The first player to score 3 points wins!

imv.description: Fall is here and Purple is this season's biggest color. Celebrate fall by watching these gently falling purple leaves flutter in the breeze. Be stylish and stress-free at the same time.

imv.description: From snowy landscapes in the winter, to sunny beaches in the summer, spice up your conversation with the some of the most interesting seasonal photos on Flickr.

imv.name: The Thread
imv.description: Do you love celebrity style? Then watch the Thread while you chat. The Thread brings you the hottest styles from your favorite TV shows, movies and music videos.
